title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 27
intro: Round 27 (2026-11-08). Your two rules are in the shared rules for every article: humanize only after the article makes sense, and your beliefs stay wherever they bear on what the reader does, never written for you. Round 25's cut is in too. A fresh read for things the guide explains twice found nine; three of them carried a reason of yours, so they stayed, and six went ([each one](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h36-20261108/overcompletion/RESULTS.md)).

Two fresh readers read the guide for your beliefs ([what dropped out since your post of 3 November](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h37-20261108/beliefs/LOST.md), [where it's generic](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h37-20261108/beliefs/GENERIC.md)). Your stories and remedies came through. What went was mostly the sentences that said why, cut as repeats in round 1, and the sections people use when someone is actually in trouble (the helper, the scripts, the fear loop, grounding, the aftermath) carry little of your method at the moment it would be used.

So two cards put sentences of your post back where they bear, and two teaching cards are the stretches that would teach me the most and lack your method most where it's used. A fresh reader read each for sense first, and the card says what it found, so your version can fix that too and nothing needs redoing after.

suggestions.title: The Fear/Panic Loop: what to do when fear starts answering fear
suggestions.reading: As the guide had it before the drug-neutral lines: [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/bf00f88a-5e89-4654-b9cf-0052ffb526f9); after the first five minutes: [67%](https://www.pangram.com/history/c52b72da-5c1e-438e-ba6d-adeebeac5d23) (the text starts with the first five minutes: that's the base each part is checked after, not a merge).
suggestions.tested:
Each after the first five minutes (the text starts with the first five minutes: that's the base each part is checked after, not a merge):

1. The paragraph alone: [97%](https://www.pangram.com/history/9e3624eb-8f0c-4695-b70b-3394f429739b); with its last line folded into the one before: [100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/5103a06f-b5e5-4132-84c9-68601f8474f9).

2. The loop breaker alone: [51%](https://www.pangram.com/history/d9a26311-3d72-415a-b649-f126a85dddaf); its second step said as talk ("while you're peaking, it's no time for ..."): [62%](https://www.pangram.com/history/09f8dafb-2008-4bc4-96cd-061392c7c574).

3. Your round-22 move carried (how it feels, then "but", and "we call that fear trying to solve fear"): [100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/a01b6a35-29db-47c2-a991-2a765c368c4c).

4. Your After the Storm moves carried (a question to the reader in the middle of it, why and not only what): [100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/d366e7fb-8b17-4dd8-a062-247711d591c6).
suggestions.sense: "Move down the ladder" points to a ladder the reader has never been shown: the first five minutes calls it "a useful order" and adds "meaning" as a fifth step, and Shadow Thoughts adds "and love". Its four words say no action, "human" least of all. "Stop debating" says what not to do but not what to do instead, and "at the peak" doesn't say peak of what. "This is a wave" is already said twice elsewhere. Nothing says who speaks each line, the person or the helper. My tries kept every step as it was, so none of this is fixed in them ([the read](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h37-20261108/beliefs/SENSE-LOOP.md)).
suggestions.why: It's where fear loops, and the guide's answer has none of your method in it: it names the fear and waits it out. What you say elsewhere in the guide bears on it: "Hatred, fear, shame, pride, and rage make hooks. Love removes hooks." and "there's nothing in love for it to grab" (Demons), "Can I send love to the one who's suffering?" (the helper's self-talk), and "Then return to room, body, human, time, and love." (Shadow Thoughts). The same shape, what to do or say to yourself when it's bad, is in Alone at 3 a.m., the Grounding Menu's breath line, Shadow Thoughts' in-trip move and the two scripts in Get One Human Anchor.
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: say what you'd want someone to do when fear starts answering fear, with your method in it. Keep the steps that keep them safe, or tell me which can go. I'll carry what you do to the stretches named above, test each, and put the ones that read Human straight in.

suggestions.title: What Kind of Aftermath Is This?: what helps in the days after
suggestions.reading: As the guide had it on 7 November (before the trauma line's cut and the drug-neutral lines), after the first five minutes (the text starts with the first five minutes: that's the base each part is checked after, not a merge): [58%](https://www.pangram.com/history/dee747e1-631a-445c-b30f-d25d8cbb930f).
suggestions.tested:
1. Its first two kinds in your Give the Session frame, my words, after the first five minutes (the text starts with the first five minutes: that's the base each part is checked after, not a merge): [AI Detected, 56%](https://www.pangram.com/history/808d56ff-7233-4aef-82ce-9b9092a6cd65), my five sentences AI High.

2. The same two kinds alone, fixed where three fresh readers agreed on the tells: [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/bd962b1b-99ca-487b-ac0f-1554e3b01a7d).

3. The same two kinds alone, written from a fresh reader's comparison of your Give the Session with my try (qualifiers inside the claims, an "although" in the middle, the reader's case first): [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/0ec38b6c-3395-42a6-b2ff-438096efe532).
suggestions.sense: Four of the kinds are labels a reader can't match to themselves: "derealization and depersonalization", "HPPD-like" (never spelled out), "somatic hyperarousal" and "psychosis-like beliefs". Most lines name a kind of help, not something to do ("grounding", "sleep hygiene", "reduced stimulation", "less rumination", "CBT-style reality testing", "practical love"), and six of the eight end on the same "get help if it's bad" line that "Bring in mental-health support when:" at the top already gives. Sorting yourself into these labels sits oddly with After the Storm's "Don't make huge decisions or diagnose yourself from an intense night." My tries covered only the first two kinds and kept their help as it was ([the read](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h37-20261108/beliefs/SENSE-AFTERMATH.md)).
suggestions.why: It's what to do in the days after, and it has none of your method. What you say elsewhere in the guide bears on it: "Send love to the part of you still waiting for them." (Dealing With Sorrow), "Most negative mind-states aren't some error in your philosophy, they're just young parts of you that are still waiting for love and protection and permission ..." (The Other Bypass), "So instead, she let the anxiety come, and accepted the feeling until it left." (your Give the Session), and "So train before you need it, sending love to a frightening image ..." (Demons). The same shape, a kind of trouble and what helps it, is in the thinking traps under (Re)defining, Abuse Memories' step after sleep, the questions after this list, and Who to Contact's directories.
